question: What severance should be practiced then, and what further gradation applies to impressions?
premises: Then severance of those tattva-bonds should be practiced.
In this fourfold, impressions have another higher-and-lower.
inference: Practice severance of the tattva-bonds; impressions in the fourfold are further graded as higher and lower.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the fourfold is not explicit.
The precise syntactic role of aparāṃ is unclear.
plain_english: Then one should practice severing those bonds of principles; and in this fourfold, impressions are further distinguished as higher and lower.
